summary: Markets appear mixed but risk-on overall in crypto, with several traders leaning into selected altcoins while macro commentary is cautious ahead of US inflation data and a firmer dollar. Commodities are more defensive, with gold pressured by dollar strength and crude remaining supported but still vulnerable to positioning reversals.
